bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls enabling regulated insurers to adopt analytics and ML capabilities within compliant architectures.
Established a shared-responsibility operating model clarifying AWS versus insurer-owned control boundaries for regulated cloud deployments.
Led AWS modernization execution to migrate monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads to cloud architecture.
